decks.notes: The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to play low cost spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also enabling the aggressive strategy with cheap and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent. The deck aims to consistently apply pressure on the opponent and quickly close out the game through a combination of card advantage, disruption, and evasive threats.

The focus of this deck is to quickly cycle through the deck to gather key combo pieces, prevent opponent from dealing damage with "Fog" effects, and draw additional cards with spells like "Accumulated Knowledge" and "Behold the Multiverse". It aims to stall the game while setting up an overwhelming advantage with card advantage and mana ramp spells like "Growth Spiral". The deck utilizes both blue and green cards to control the board and outvalue the opponent in a slow, methodical manner.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using a combination of counterspells and removal spells. It aims to control the board while digging through the deck for key cards with cantrips like Brainstorm, Thought Scour, and Mental Note. The deck also utilizes creatures like Tolarian Terror and Gurmag Angler to apply pressure and close out the game. Lórien Revealed provides card advantage, while Snuff Out offers a powerful removal option. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game and outvaluing the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, to play powerful creatures like Eldrazi Repurposer and Annoyed Altisaur, and to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. With a focus on efficient creatures and mana acceleration, this Gruul Aggro deck aims to build a strong board presence early in the game and maintain pressure on the opponent throughout the match.

The main focus of this Golgari/Jund Garden Control deck is to control the game through removal spells and creature sacrifices while generating card advantage with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Tithing Blade. The deck also utilizes tokens from Khalni Garden and recursion from Witch's Cottage to maintain board presence. With a mix of spot removal, board wipes, and card advantage, this deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win in a long game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing removal spells and sacrificing creatures to gain advantage. The deck focuses on generating card advantage through effects like Ichor Wellspring and Lembas, while also utilizing powerful threats like Thorn of the Black Rose and Troll of Khazad-dûm. The deck also has ways to deal with opposing creatures through cards like Defile and Crypt Rats. Additionally, the deck has some recursion with Witch's Cottage and Haunted Mire, allowing for a flexible and resilient game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tolarian Terror, while also controlling the game with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with bounce spells like Boomerang and card draw spells like Thought Scour and Brainstorm. By efficiently managing resources and applying pressure early on, this Mono Blue Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory in a Pauper 1 vs 1 matchup.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggressive strategy. It utilizes low-cost creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, along with counterspells and bounce spells to maintain control and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Card draw and deck manipulation are key components to ensure a consistent flow of threats and answers. By applying constant pressure and disruption, the Mono Blue Aggro deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total and secure a victory before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to gain advantages and control the board. It utilizes cards like Crypt Rats, Deadly Dispute, and Fanatical Offering to manage opponent's creatures and generate value. The deck also includes removal spells like Cast Down, Defile, and Snuff Out to deal with threats efficiently. Khalni Garden and Ichor Wellspring provide additional sacrifice fodder, while cards like Avenging Hunter and Thorn of the Black Rose offer win conditions. The deck aims to create a resource advantage and outvalue the opponent while disrupting their game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly cycling through the deck to assemble a key combo while stalling the opponent with fog effects and counterspells. The key cards include Lórien Revealed and Stream of Thought to continually draw cards and recycle important cards back into the library. The deck aims to use its mana efficiently with cards like Growth Spiral and Simic Growth Chamber to quickly ramp up and cast its combo pieces. The goal is to outlast the opponent and eventually overwhelm them with a powerful combo finish.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on efficiently deploying creatures and controlling the board through removal spells and value-generating creatures. By utilizing cards like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher to repeatedly return artifacts to hand, the deck aims to maintain a steady stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Cast Down. The inclusion of Inspiring Overseer provides a powerful anthem effect for the deck's aggro strategy, while cards like Thorn of the Black Rose offer additional card advantage. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggression and disruption.

The deck is focused on fast and aggressive gameplay, using low-cost goblin creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. With a strong emphasis on maximizing damage output, cards like Goblin Bushwhacker and Goblin Grenade are key components of this strategy. The deck also includes cards like Skirk Prospector and Mogg Raider to generate mana quickly and efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on and secure a swift victory through aggressive tactics and efficient use of resources.

The deck is focused on playing cheap artifacts creatures and using them along with spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Myr Enforcer, Galvanic Blast, and Krark-Clan Shaman to pressure the opponent while also generating card advantage with cards like Thoughtcast and Ichor Wellspring. The deck also includes some disruption in the form of Nihil Spellbomb and Cast Down to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of low-cost white creatures, utilizing cards like Guardians' Pledge and Battle Screech to pump up the team. Cards like Militia Bugler and Kor Skyfisher provide card advantage and potential recursion, while Prismatic Strands offers protection against removal spells. The goal is to quickly build a wide board presence and apply pressure on the opponent, using cards like Lunarch Veteran and Thraben Charm to maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to win through fast and efficient aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing removal spells like Spinning Darkness, Defile, and Cast Down to clear the opponent's board. The deck also includes sacrifice effects with cards like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering to generate card advantage. Additionally, the deck features cards like Ichor Wellspring and Lembas to draw cards and generate value. Crypt Rats serve as a board wipe option, while Troll of Khazad-dûm provides a resilient threat. The mana base includes utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Witch's Cottage to disrupt the opponent's graveyard strategies.

This deck focuses on creating a loop of sacrificing creatures to trigger effects that benefit the player, such as drawing cards and dealing damage to the opponent. By using cards like Sadistic Glee and Malevolent Rumble in conjunction with sacrifice outlets like Deadly Dispute and Makeshift Munitions, the player can generate significant value and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes ways to ramp and fix mana, ensuring a smooth combo execution. Overall, the strategy revolves around sacrificing creatures for maximum value and control over the game.
